title: Heavy Rain
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#767, 2026-10-29), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal with AVX advertised, rated 1 of 5: the origami loading screen shows for under five seconds and the game crashes, on both graphics modes tried. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Crashes a few seconds into its first loading screen on an M1 (D3DMetal's DirectX 11 at 59.5 fps on that screen, then exit). Beyond: Two Souls, from the same studio's PC ports, runs on DXMT, which is the next mode to try.

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes a few seconds into the first loading screen (origami in the corner)
knownIssues.fix: none known. Untested: DXMT as the game's mode
